{{Quote|If you want juicy conversation and a hot cup of ardees, come to Dexter's Diner. If you want a ''good'' cup of ardees, try Biscuit Baron.|Slyther Bushforb|<ref name="cacw">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>}}
'''Ardees''' was a sharp, bitter [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage made by the [[Ardees Beverage Company/Legends|Ardees Beverage Company]]. It was nicknamed '''Jawa juice''' by many who consumed it.

==History==
{{Quote|You want a cup of Jawa Juice?|FLO to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The traditional recipe was made from [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] [[Bantha hide/Legends|hide]] and fermented [[Grain/Legends|grains]], but there were many different forms, including non-alcoholic versions, served in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was offered a cup of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] juice by [[FLO/Legends|FLO]] while at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] investigating the origin of a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|mysterious saberdart]]. .

The [[Biscuit Baron]] restaurant chain was known to serve Ardees. 

Jawa juice was also served at [[Bantha Traxx]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. By [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], ardees was still being served by [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ardees was named after [[Ardees Rabang Jundis]], assistant to [[Rick McCallum]].<ref name="Databank: WA-7 (Behind the scenes)">{{DB|droid|wa7|FLO (WA-7)}}</ref>

In the original script and pre-release cuts of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']], [[FLO/Legends|WA-7]] offers [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] a cup of ardees, although the name was changed to Jawa juice in the final version of the film.<ref name="Databank: WA-7 (Behind the scenes)" /> The [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization of the film]] and German dub of the movie, however, use the original name in this scene.

When [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] visited the [[Lars family|Lars]] ranch on Tatooine, [[Beru Whitesun Lars|Beru]] offered them cups of a hot drink, which the script called ardees, although in the film itself the beverage is not named.

Ardees appeared in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the [[Star Wars video games|game]], ardees could be [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|purchased]] from [[Bartender/Legends|bartenders]] in [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
